name: green-zone-ob-edge-selection
note: Super OrderBlock's OB edge selection: `ob.up_bottom()` is math.min(low[1], low) and `ob.down_top()` is math.max(high[1], high), while the OPPOSITE edge of each is a single bar (high[1] / low[1]). That asymmetry is deliberate — see stdlib/ob.os — and it is the term most likely to be mistyped. TWO SPAWNS PER SIDE ARE MANDATORY, and this is the whole design of the fixture: min(a,b) always EQUALS one of its operands, so a single spawn cannot tell math.min(low[1], low) apart from whichever operand happened to win, and half the mutation space would survive. The pairs have OPPOSITE orderings. OB+ spawns at s=2 (x1=0) where low[s-2]=90 < low[s-1]=100 so bottom=90 — a mutation to bare `low` yields 100 and fails; and at s=4 (x1=2) where low[s-1]=107 < low[s-2]=108 so bottom=107 — a mutation to bare `low[1]` yields 108 and fails. OB- spawns at s=7 (x1=5) where high[s-2]=123 > high[s-1]=122 so top=123 — a mutation to bare `high` yields 122 and fails; and at s=9 (x1=7) where high[s-1]=125 > high[s-2]=121 so top=125 — a mutation to bare `high[1]` yields 121 and fails. Swapping the bullish and bearish asymmetry also fails: OB+ at s=2 would take max(106,111)=111 instead of high[s-2]=106. x1 = s-2 on every item pins offset=-2. The OB- zone at s=7 is straddled by bar 8 (high 125 > top 123 > low 114) and closes mitigated, which exercises the lifecycle; bar 4's high of exactly 110 against the 110 bottom edge of no zone here is incidental, but bar 4's low of 114 staying above the 113 top of the s=4 zone is what keeps that zone open.
source:
indicator("OBE", shorttitle="OBE", overlay=true)
plotzone(ob.up()[1], ob.up_top()[1], ob.up_bottom()[1], "OB+", offset=-2, extend=extend.until, terminate=terminate.straddle, max_kept=10)
plotzone(ob.down()[1], ob.down_top()[1], ob.down_bottom()[1], "OB-", offset=-2, extend=extend.until, terminate=terminate.straddle, max_kept=10)
